newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Brent unquoted, NYMEX edges down in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent unquoted, NYMEX edges down in modest trade.

text.p: September Brent crude futures were unquoted at midday in Asia while NYMEX crudes gave up overnight gains.
NYMEX September futures trading on ACCESS were last traded at $19.41 per barrel, down seven cents from New York, which gained six cents overnight.
In New York trading, the August contract expired and fell as players sold it in favour of the September contract.
But they said the underlying market sentiment remained cautious of the upside because of an increasing time crunch for Iraq to sell the first $1 billion of crude.
However, the API data, released after the close of New York trading, was bullish as they revealed strong gasoline demand.
